question: Please list the product description of the products bought in transactions in euro.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tx_customer_product" AS SELECT
  t3.transactionid,
  t3.customerid,
  t3.productid,
  t2.description AS product_description,
  t1.huobi
FROM table_3 AS t3
LEFT JOIN table_1 AS t1
  ON t3.customerid = t1.customerid
LEFT JOIN table_2 AS t2
  ON CAST(t3.productid AS VARCHAR) = t2.productid

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tx_customer_product" AS CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tx_customer_product AS
SELECT
  t.transactionid,
  t.customerid,
  t.productid,
  TRIM(p.description) AS product_description,
  c.huobi AS huobi
FROM table_3 t
LEFT JOIN table_1 c
  ON t.customerid = c.customerid
LEFT JOIN table_2 p
  ON CAST(t.productid AS VARCHAR) = TRIM(p.productid)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tx_customer_product" AS SELECT
  t.transactionid,
  t.customerid,
  t.productid,
  TRIM(p.description) AS product_description,
  c.huobi AS huobi

S:
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT product_description
FROM tx_customer_product
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(huobi)) = 'EUR'
  AND product_description IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(product_description) <> ''
ORDER BY product_description
""")
